title: Multi-agent framework used in this workshop
points: The five roles share the same case facts and checked results.
One Llama model handles planning and refinement. Python calculates and checks.
note: The implementation names five roles: Awareness Agent, Planning Agent, Simulation Agent, Verification Agent and LLM Optimizer. Awareness reads the case. Planning prepares permitted candidates and can ask Llama which initial study to request. Simulation runs a case-specific numerical tool. Verification checks limits, case identity and model scope. The optimizer requests bounded changes or ranks passing candidates. Every changed trial returns to simulation and verification. Python guards the ranking and performs a final recheck before operator review. One Llama model serves the planning and optimizer roles; the other stages run in Python. This is a custom role-based Python workflow, not five independent language models and not a live multi-agent run in the default Colab. The solar, restoration and cyber cases use different numerical adapters behind the same stages. The six matched comparisons have five tied final costs and one worse Llama route; the framework does not establish a general performance gain.
caption: Saved five-role Python workflow. L10 replays its recorded trace.
